purpose: Freeze the first AFK nonmaximal order-ray monoid adapter before any target functional evaluation.
claim_boundary: This pilot may validate an adapter or certify a radical value for its single frozen row. It cannot establish quadratic support, an AFK packet identification, or TCC.

pilot.role: smallest positive-form-conductor row in the frozen d<=1024 local-kernel ledger

required_before_target_evaluation: Exact multiplication table of the AFK flat O_f-invertible ray monoid, with a stable basis order.
Independent reproduction of the frozen d=7 tuple and f=2 order data.
Independent reproduction of the AFK squared-overlap class labels for a declared finite characteristic sample.
Exact rational basis for the Jacobson radical of the monoid algebra, independently checked by nilpotence and quotient dimension.
A source-derived exact formula or separately preregistered rigorous enclosure method for the AFK differenced partial-zeta functional.

evaluation_rule.nonzero_rule: A nonzero radical value requires exact arithmetic or a rigorous complex enclosure excluding zero with its radius and margin recorded.
evaluation_rule.zero_rule: Vanishing on this pilot is a single-row result only and does not promote a uniform descent claim.
evaluation_rule.failed_check_rule: Retain a versioned failed-row artifact and halt the pilot.

resource_cap.substitution_rule: No unregistered numerical or heuristic substitute is permitted after a cap.
